rules.message: AppsFlyer accepts only HTTPS incoming engagement traffic.
The complete attribution URL must not exceed2000 characters.
These PID characters prevent attribution and deep linking.
Campaign names should not begin or end with whitespace because reporting may disagree.
URI fragments are unsupported in redirection URLs.
Ad-network links should carry the publisher site ID. Custom owned-media impression examples omit it.
A customized OneLink social preview uses title, description and image together.
